links.outcome: LLM accuracy against AUA/SUFU guideline recommendations for postprostatectomy incontinence
links.effect: ChatGPT scored 19/20 (95.0%) and DeepSeek 14.5/20 (72.5%; p = 0.031). DeepSeek made critical treatment errors, such as recommending a male sling for radiated patients.
links.quote: DeepSeek made critical errors in the treatment domain, such as recommending a male sling for radiated patients.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and compares the accuracy of two LLMs (ChatGPT-4o and DeepSeek R1) against clinical guidelines for managing postprostatectomy urinary incontinence using conceptual and case-based questions.
